{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())
print(df['status'].value_counts())
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Check for formatting
print(f"Number of rows: {len(df)}")

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")

# Confirm the two channels
print(f"Channels: {df['channel'].unique()}")"}
